allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                A customer code assigned on create, formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where CITY3
                is the upper-cased first three letters of city, LAST3 the upper-cased first three
                letters of lastName, and NNNN a per-city 4-digit zero-padded sequence equal to one
                more than the number of owners already in that city at creation time.
              type: string
              example: 'SYD-SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the owner's
                customerCode (non-digit characters ignored).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                A membership number derived on create, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where
                customerCode is the owner's customer code and YY is the last two digits of the
                registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'SYD-SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by all owners who live together at the same
                address, assigned when an owner is created with 'sharesHousehold' true.
                Every member of the household receives the same value.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6A7B8'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of owners that already existed, at the time this owner was
                created, sharing the same firstName and lastName (compared
                case-insensitively). Assigned on create.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level (1-3), assigned on create: starts at 1,
                add 1 when an email is present, add 1 when namesakeCount is 0, capped at 3
                (level 4 is reserved for tenure).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Whether, at the time this owner was created, more than 80 owners had already
                been created for the same (business-day-adjusted) registration date. Assigned
                on create; false otherwise.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The region derived on read from the owner's city using a fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD),
                or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The preferred contact channel derived on read: 'EMAIL' when the
                owner has an email address, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single derived value all duplicate detection is expressed through,
                formatted 'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' where the telephone is in
                E.164 form, the email is lower-cased (empty when absent), and householdId is
                the owner's shared-household identifier (empty when not in a shared
                household). A create is rejected with 409 only when a new owner's whole
                identityKey equals an existing owner's.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||A1B2C3D4E5F6A7B8'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band derived on read from 'birthDate' measured against
                'registrationDate': 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18-64 and
                'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

                more than the number of owners already in that city at creation time.
              type: string
              example: 'SYD-SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true

              title: Check digit
              description: >-

                customerCode (non-digit characters ignored).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                A membership number derived on create, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where
                customerCode is the owner's customer code and YY is the last two digits of the
                registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'SYD-SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by all owners who live together at the same
                address, assigned when an owner is created with 'sharesHousehold' true.
                Every member of the household receives the same value.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6A7B8'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of owners that already existed, at the time this owner was
                created, sharing the same firstName and lastName (compared
                case-insensitively). Assigned on create.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level (1-3), assigned on create: starts at 1,
                add 1 when an email is present, add 1 when namesakeCount is 0, capped at 3
                (level 4 is reserved for tenure).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true

              description: >-

                been created for the same (business-day-adjusted) registration date. Assigned
                on create; false otherwise.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The region derived on read from the owner's city using a fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD),
                or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string

              readOnly: true

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            An optional 4-digit postcode. When present it must be valid for the owner's
            city per a fixed city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne->VIC
            3000-3099, Brisbane->QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any
            4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when supplied.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. When omitted on create, it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional; when
            supplied it drives the derived 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allows creating this owner even if another owner shares the same last name and address (e.g. a spouse or family member at the same address).
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                A customer code assigned on create, formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where CITY3
                is the upper-cased first three letters of city, LAST3 the upper-cased first three
                letters of lastName, and NNNN a per-city 4-digit zero-padded sequence equal to one
                more than the number of owners already in that city at creation time.
              type: string
              example: 'SYD-SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the owner's
                customerCode (non-digit characters ignored).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                A membership number derived on create, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where
                customerCode is the owner's customer code and YY is the last two digits of the
                registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'SYD-SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by all owners who live together at the same
                address, assigned when an owner is created with 'sharesHousehold' true.
                Every member of the household receives the same value.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6A7B8'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of owners that already existed, at the time this owner was
                created, sharing the same firstName and lastName (compared
                case-insensitively). Assigned on create.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level (1-3), assigned on create: starts at 1,
                add 1 when an email is present, add 1 when namesakeCount is 0, capped at 3
                (level 4 is reserved for tenure).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Whether, at the time this owner was created, more than 80 owners had already
                been created for the same (business-day-adjusted) registration date. Assigned
                on create; false otherwise.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The region derived on read from the owner's city using a fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD),
                or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The preferred contact channel derived on read: 'EMAIL' when the
                owner has an email address, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single derived value all duplicate detection is expressed through,
                formatted 'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' where the telephone is in
                E.164 form, the email is lower-cased (empty when absent), and householdId is
                the owner's shared-household identifier (empty when not in a shared
                household). A create is rejected with 409 only when a new owner's whole
                identityKey equals an existing owner's.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||A1B2C3D4E5F6A7B8'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band derived on read from 'birthDate' measured against
                'registrationDate': 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18-64 and
                'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

## Summary

I implemented the soft-match "possible duplicate" rule for `POST /api/owners`. A new owner that isn't a hard duplicate but shares an existing owner's `lastName` (case-insensitive) and `postcode` is still created, and returns `possibleDuplicate: true` with `possibleDuplicateOf` set to the matching owner's id; otherwise `possibleDuplicate: false`.

Changes:
- **`openapi.yml`** — added `possibleDuplicate` (boolean) and `possibleDuplicateOf` (int32) read-only properties to the `Owner` schema, so the generated `OwnerDto` exposes them.
- **`Owner.java`** — added `possibleDuplicate`/`possibleDuplicateOf` columns with getters/setters.
- **DB schemas** (hsqldb, h2, mysql, postgres) — added `possible_duplicate` / `possible_duplicate_of` columns (tests use the `hsqldb` profile with `ddl-auto=none`, so the column had to be declared).
- **`AssignPossibleDuplicate.java`** — new OfficeFloor function following the existing `Assign*` convention: scans existing owners for a `lastName`+`postcode` match and records the lowest matching id. It runs after `BuildOwner` and before `SaveOwner`, so the new owner isn't compared against itself, mirroring `AssignBulkSignupWarning`/`AssignNamesakeCount`.
- **`owners.POST.yml`** — wired the new `assignPossibleDuplicate` step (under `govern: [ transaction ]`) between `assignBulkSignupWarning` and `save`.
- **`OwnerMapper.java`** — added a non-null default mapping for `possibleDuplicate` (mirroring `bulkSignupWarning`); `possibleDuplicateOf` maps by name automatically.

Because a hard duplicate (whole `identityKey` match) is already rejected with 409 by `RequireUniqueIdentity` upstream, any surviving `lastName`+`postcode` match reaching this step is by definition a non-hard duplicate, matching the spec exactly.
